correctness.rationale: Two standard-library verifiers run on distinct GP(8,3) and LCF [5,-5]^8 graph encodings. Exhaustive candidate enumeration proves minimum basis size four and exactly 320 bases; explicit legal moves and full all-pairs BFS versus Floyd–Warshall prove 1,984/576 edges, radii, diameters, every pair histogram and 136 maximum-extra-distance pairs. Automorphism backtracking finds all 96 permutations and six orbit sizes. Exact programs and passing outputs are embedded.

value.rationale: This finite computation answers the natural optimum sensor-relocation problem on a canonical cubic symmetric, non-distance-transitive graph. Full geodesic spectra and a sharp eight-move movement penalty document substantive structural behavior rather than only recomputing the known metric dimension. The six optimizer symmetry orbits make the data reusable as an exact benchmark.
